# Draft:2026 Heritage Classic

The 2026 NHL Heritage Classic (branded as the 2026 Tim Hortons NHL Heritage Classic for sponsorship reasons) will be an outdoor regular season National Hockey League (NHL) game. The game, the eighth Heritage Classic, will be between the Montreal Canadiens and the Winnipeg Jets, played at Princess Auto Stadium, home of the Canadian Football League's Winnipeg Blue Bombers on October 25, 2026.
